title: 上传与导入页布局优化 · 独立验收（I1–I9）

summary.note: All nine items were judged from headed Chromium real-window measurements and screenshots on wondron, not from implementer source mapping. I4 and I8 have documented evidence boundaries (no business backend ingest).

backend/tests/test_index_repository.py.note: Already different from the implementer handoff when this acceptance started. Not rolled back. Unchanged during this acceptance.

isolated_preview.note: Did not use or switch the user's already-running Vite on :5173 (PID 11904, --host 0.0.0.0). Proxy target pointed at a closed port so accidental /api calls would not hit a business service. Did not change vite.config.ts, config.yaml, Nacos, or production baseUrl.

playwright_final.earlier_runs: Run 1: I2 timed out because ?view=import is ignored by App.initialView() (only enums/categories/scenes). Fixed by clicking the sidebar. Run 2: I6 failed because at 580px the sidebar is off-canvas; gotoImport now widens, clicks, then restores the target viewport. Run 3 is the formal suite.

supplemental.purpose: I5 occupancy at left-column scrollTop=0 (7.5rem check) and I6 wrap at 400px.

points.title: 宽屏空队列同一行
points.evidence: 选择图片 and 选择目录 are on one row with 把图片拖到这里 to their right (chooser tops 131.7, dropzone 123.5–177.8, stretch-aligned). Format hint and 自建入库已接入 sit in .mg-import-meta above the pickup row (meta bottom 100.8, pickup top 123.5). Dropzone hint is “或使用左侧「选择图片」/「选择目录」添加文件” (no “顶部的”). Directory picker is available in this Chromium.

points.title: 宽屏加长队列只滚左列
points.evidence: 40 local PNGs made the left column overflow (scrollHeight 5540 / clientHeight 874). After scrolling the left column to the bottom (scrollTop 4666), main stayed overflow:hidden with scrollTop 0, window scrollY 0. Aside remained fully in main (sticky, max-height 916px = 100dvh-56-28), 批量标注 title and 开始入库 were fully visible and hit-tested at the button. After injecting a temporary 1400px form min-height via page.addStyleTag (removed after the test, not written to the worktree), only .mg-import-settings-body scrolled and 开始入库 did not move.

points.title: 人为让 main 成为滚动容器
points.evidence: Temporary page.addStyleTag forced main.import-page { overflow:auto } and relaxed .mg-page-import / left-column height so the left column could stretch. After scrolling main (scrollTop 4666, scrollHeight 5610, clientHeight 944), window still did not scroll. Aside stayed position:sticky; top:0; max-height:916px (not 100%). 批量标注 title and 开始入库 remained fully inside main and hit-testable. The style tag was removed from the page; leftover=false. Worktree CSS was not modified.

points.title: 入库进行中状态与拖拽禁用
points.evidence_boundary: No isolated backend and no POST /api/index. indexing was toggled on the live page via React fiber setState (useState index 8) plus indexingRef. This checks meta copy, placement, and dropzone disabled styling, not a full ingest integration.
points.evidence: After injection, .mg-import-meta .mg-status read “入库进行中” and stayed in meta (not in the pickup row). Dropzone class included is-disabled, pointer-events was none, and 选择图片 was disabled. State was reverted before later tests.

points.title: ≤860px 底栏批量标注

rem_7_5.note: 7.5rem (112.5px) is 3px above the measured meta+gap+pickup occupancy (109.5px). 52dvh at 1000px viewport is 520px and was the binding max-height (tighter than 100dvh-topbar-28-7.5rem). The first-suite rem check was taken after scrolling the left column, so pickup was off-screen; the formal 7.5rem occupancy numbers above come from the supplemental headed remasurement at scrollTop=0. The bottom panel did not cover pickup and 开始入库 stayed at the panel bottom while the form body scrolled.

points.evidence: At 860×1000 with a 40-item queue, after scrolling the left column, the 批量标注 panel stayed in the visible main (aside height 520, sticky bottom), 开始入库 was fully visible and hit-testable, and the form body scrolled without moving the run bar. No new Dialog or drawer. Pickup was not covered at rest (see rem_7_5).

points.title: 极窄折行
points.evidence: At 580×900 the off-canvas sidebar leaves ~523px for the pickup row, which is still enough for two buttons + ~200px dropzone (need ≈438px), so the dropzone stayed on the same row as the two chooser buttons. Status stayed in meta. Because the spec also requires checking the “cannot fit two buttons + ~200px dropzone” case, a supplemental 400×800 remasurement was done: the two chooser buttons remained side by side, the dropzone wrapped to the next line, and the status chip stayed in meta / not in the pickup row.

points.title: 窄高
points.evidence: Viewport height 600 < 644px CSS breakpoint. Remaining main height 544px (< 560). Form visible clientHeight 45px (< 160). Form scrollHeight 1540, overflow auto. 开始入库 fully inside main and hit-testable; dropzone subtitle hidden as specified. html overflow hidden, window not scrollable (maxY 0). Aside sticky with max-height 516px (= 600-56-28). No dual window/main scrollbar carried the rail out of view.

points.title: 业务回归（本地队列，无真实入库）
points.evidence_boundary: Did not POST /api/index or write a business DB/OSS. Local temp PNGs only. Start/cancel/retry checked as visible entry points; 取消入库 was clicked after frontend indexing-state injection, not after a live run.
points.evidence: File input and 选择目录 are present (directory picker available). A drag-and-drop of one PNG enqueued 1 item; adding three more via the hidden file input brought the queue to 4. 单独标注 was clicked; a role=dialog was not detected (Dialog.tsx is out of this knife; a larger screenshot was still captured). 开始入库 was visible and enabled (no annotation blockers in this session). After injecting indexing=true, 取消入库 appeared, clicking it returned meta text to “自建入库已接入”. 查看任务中心 jumped to title 入库任务. Focus restore of Dialog was observed only in passing and is not a knife fail.

points.title: 导航、品牌色与其它页未被 import-page 误伤
points.evidence: import uses management-page import-page + mg-page-import. library uses library-page / mg-page-library without import-page. tasks uses management-page / mg-page without import-page (main overflow remains auto, as before). search uses search-page, overflow hidden. --primary stayed #2c56a0 and sidebar width 200px on all four views. Nav items 图搜图 / 图片数据 / 上传与导入 / 入库任务 unchanged.
